mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS member_id, u.full_name, u.email, r.name AS rank, jf.name AS job_title, jt.name AS job_level FROM public.user_departments ud JOIN public.users u ON ud.user_id = u.id JOIN public.job_titles jt ON u.job_title_id = jt.id JOIN public.ranks r ON jt.rank_id = r.id JOIN public.job_families jf ON jt.job_family_id = jf.id WHERE ud.supervisor_id = #{leaderId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.is_active = true AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND jf.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT ON (kas.user_id) kas.user_id AS member_id, kas.user_full_name AS full_name, kas.user_email AS email, r.name AS rank, jf.name AS job_title, jt.name AS job_level FROM public.kpi_assignment_snapshots kas LEFT JOIN public.job_titles jt ON kas.job_title_id = jt.id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public.ranks r ON jt.rank_id = r.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN public.job_families jf ON jt.job_family_id = jf.id AND jf.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE kas.supervisor_id = #{leaderId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND kas.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND kas.user_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_departments (user_id, department_id, supervisor_id, is_primary) VALUES (#{userId}, #{departmentId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{supervisorId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.company.kpi.common.mybatis.UUIDTypeHandler}, TRUE) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_departments WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_primary = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT ud.department_id FROM public.user_departments ud JOIN public.departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT ud.department_id FROM public.user_departments ud JOIN public.departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(u.id AS VARCHAR) AS id, u.full_name AS name, u.email AS email, r.code AS rankCode FROM user_departments ud INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(u.is_active, TRUE) = TRUE INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN roles ro ON ro.id = ur.role_id AND ro.deleted_at IS NULL AND ro.code = 'MEMBER' LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON jt.id = u.job_title_id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ranks r ON r.id = jt.rank_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ud.department_id = #{departmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.id IS DISTINCT FROM ( SELECT d.manager_id FROM departments d WHERE d.id = #{departmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY u.full_name

SELECT ud.user_id FROM user_departments ud INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(u.is_active, TRUE) = TRUE WHERE ud.department_id = #{departmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ud.supervisor_id = #{leaderId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY u.full_name
mapper.update: UPDATE user_departments ud SET supervisor_id = d.manager_id FROM departments d WHERE ud.department_id = d.id AND d.id = #{departmentId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ud.supervisor_id = #{leaderId, jdbcType=OTHER}
